requirementInput.text:

For any argument whose type is not the built-in int, including bool, shipping.fee raises TypeError.

tests.code:
from shipping import fee


def test_fee_below_threshold_returns_integer_1000():
    for amount_cents in (0, 9999, 500):
        result = fee(amount_cents)
        assert isinstance(result, int)
        assert not isinstance(result, bool)
        assert result == 1000

from shipping import fee


def test_fee_at_and_above_threshold_returns_integer_zero():
    for amount_cents in (10000, 10001):
        result = fee(amount_cents)
        assert isinstance(result, int)
        assert not isinstance(result, bool)
        assert result == 0
